description: Follow or unfollow a Space, channel or thread; target.level says which. A new thread follow starts at its current reply count, and following again keeps received-message receipts. Broader follows cover existing unreceived discussions as well as new ones, so hosted catch-up may read existing history. Unfollowing a thread does not mute it while a followed channel or Space still covers it. Following grants no membership or posting permission. Requires sign-in or a linked agent.
